interpreter_security_note: CPython 3.12.10 is the last official Python 3.12 Windows binary release, accepted solely as a compatibility-preservation reference; NOT the current-security Python 3.12 release. Later production/runtime approval must reassess the interpreter security baseline.

platform.cpu_requirements: x64 CPU supporting the preserved CPU wheel; reference Intel Core i5-12450H

bootstrap_install_steps: Follow procedure/OPERATOR.md; prepare a new standard Windows account; manually disconnect/disable all network adapters BEFORE restoration.

Execute preserved procedure/run_fp001d_offline.ps1 under the new account. Fresh per-user CPython location, full local installer, no launcher/PATH changes. Do not execute MSVC installer: existing declared host-native baseline only.
environment_steps: Fresh venv, no system-site-packages; install exactly procedure/requirements.lock with --no-index --no-cache-dir --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes. Require pip check exit 0.
start_steps: Exactly one input/acceptance.wav through definition-bound offline probe. Retain restoration, generated token, model-integrity, identity, network and verification logs.
